My mother left her voice in the city's echo shards. That's what her journal says. 'An echo never forgets what it heard.' Please gather the shards. I want to… hear her voice.
Bring 4 echo shards.
(The shards knock together and give off a faint voice.) "…Isabel, don't try to gather the whole Chronicle. Once it is whole, someone will use it." …That's my mother's voice. After fifteen years.

Chapter 1: The Ember Oath (22/29)
The Awakened Shriek

Trouble. The archivist went down into the ancient city alone to hear more of her mother's voice. When a sculk shrieker sounds, the Warden wakes. One noise and it's over. Stay crouched, slip between the sensors and bring the archivist back. Do not run.
Sneak past a sculk sensor in the ancient city and bring the archivist back. (Advancement "Sneak 100")
(Isabel clutches an echo shard with trembling hands.) …I'm sorry. I heard my mother's voice from inside the gate. But it wasn't her. Something was imitating her voice. The thing inside the gate.

Chapter 1: The Ember Oath (23/29)
The Twisted Warden

The thing imitating her mother's voice is a Warden that grew fat on souls inside the gate. The Twisted Warden. Open the Memory Gate. It has no eyes. It finds you by sound. Take the page from behind it.
Open the Memory Gate and defeat the Twisted Warden.

As the Warden fell, the trapped souls scattered. A page came up out of the dirt before the gate. "The eighth seat is empty. It was the seven who emptied it." …An eighth? The Chronicle only speaks of seven.
Warden
The second end. This time I won't make a sound.
Chapter 1: The Ember Oath (24/29)
Eyes of Ender

The last end is the void. Throw Eyes of Ender and find the stronghold underground. Inside it is the gate to the void. …Elena passed through that gate too. She never passed through the one coming back.
Use Eyes of Ender to find the stronghold.

So the stronghold's gate is open. In the void there is a dragon. Elena's last page will lie beneath it. (The Elder straightens his glove.) When you find the page, bring it to me first. It would be… too heavy for Isabel to bear.

Camp at the End of the Void

The land of the void. Elena avoided the dragon and made camp in a tower city on the outer islands. Shulkers guard the towers. Get hit and you float. Mind the fall. Look for Elena's traces at the top of the tower.
Go to the End, find an End city, and defeat 4 shulkers.

Candle marks and an ink bottle in the top room of the tower? Fourteen dates written on the wall, they say. Elena held out here for fourteen days. One line beside the last date: 'The dragon guards the gate. The last page lies beneath the gate.'

The Ending Crystal

Look at the drawing we brought back from my mother's camp. Even after the void dragon falls once, its 'true form' remains. Placing four Ending Crystals on the exit portal wakes that form. My mother was making those crystals when… her entries stop on the fourteenth day. And the Elder just sent someone. He says if we find the page, bring it straight to him, not to the archivist. …Why?
Craft one Ending Crystal and show it to Archivist Isabel. (Bring four separately for the exit portal.)
Exactly as my mother drew it. With this we can wake the dragon. …Don't say anything to the Elder yet. I'll read my mother's last page first. That's what she wanted.

Chapter 1: The Ember Oath (27/29)
The Dragon That Guards the Void

The void dragon. Place Ending Crystals on the four corners of the exit portal to wake its true form. Smash the crystals on the towers to drag it down. It changes form three times. Breath that tears the void, falling meteors, black holes… by the end it'll feel like the sky is collapsing. This is what Elena held out against for fourteen days. This time the land of the void itself is the battlefield. The whole expedition goes. Only those who deal at least 10% of the dragon's max health get credit.
Defeat the Ender Dragon (at least 10% of its max health in damage).

The dragon lost even its third form and scattered into the void. A leather cover came up out of the dirt beneath the exit portal. The last page of Elena's journal. We didn't open it. The archivist has to read it first.

Chapter 2: The Rusted Vow (1/22)
The Map from Twenty Years Ago

I suppose I have to tell you about that map. Twenty years ago the Order sent an expedition to watch the awakening guardians. Twelve of us. I was captain, Kael was my second. My closest friend. …I'm the only one who came back. The twelve red marks on the map are where my people fell. Only one is erased. Kael's. I don't know why it was erased.
Hear Captain Loran's story.
This expedition follows those marks. If we bring back even one of their name tags… that's enough. And I need to know why Kael's mark was erased.
Captain Loran: What we were chasing were the 'awakening guardians.' Sentinels the kings set beside the seals a thousand years ago.
Captain Loran: The first mark is underground. The room of the knight who guards the rusted door. We lost three there.
Captain Loran: …Let's go. This time we do it differently.

Name Tags in the Ore

In the tunnels to the rusted door live ore thieves called grottols. They swallow anything shiny. The name tags we lost in those tunnels twenty years ago must be in their bellies. They're fast. The sound of a pickaxe draws them.
Catch 2 grottols in the tunnels underground.
…Thomas, and Lia. Both got lost in the grottol tunnels. The tags are caked with ore dust. Thank you. Truly.

Chapter 2: The Rusted Vow (3/22)
The Rusted Door

At the end of the tunnels is the rusted knight's chamber. The first mark on the map. …I'll be honest. I can't stand before that door. Twenty years ago I just watched as three fell in front of it. My legs lock up. You go first. If you find a name tag by the door, take it.
Find the wrought chamber underground.

A name tag wedged between the stones by the door? …Bren. Our youngest. (Loran stands a long while, gripping the tag.) The seal no longer stops you. This time I'll come as far as the door. The knight will still be guarding it.
Wrought Chamber
